title: Safe parallel verification execution
rawUserRequest: Implement the approved 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan in performance-first order. Execute in English low-token mode; preserve separate WIs and keep each WI convergent. This WI must enable safe bounded parallel verification after performance baselining.

declaredIntent.summary: Run independent verification jobs concurrently while serializing conflicting scopes and preserving per-job evidence.

outOfScope: Changing gate policy or bypassing required checks

sources.reason: Existing Work Item-local runtime isolation semantics.

riskAssessment.reason: Parallel execution must be bounded, conflict-aware, and evidence-preserving.

reasons: Restricted schema and concurrency safety require strict verification; parallelism remains explicit and bounded.

executionDecision.reason: The contract defines a bounded local execution helper with conflict serialization.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Independent jobs run concurrently up to an explicit worker bound.
Jobs with overlapping declared scopes are serialized deterministically.
Every job receives an independent result with command, status, duration, and captured evidence.
Invalid plans, empty identifiers, and unsafe worker bounds fail closed without execution.
Schema, focused tests, and documentation cover independent, conflicting, and failing jobs.
guidelines: Serialize conflicting scopes; never infer independence.
Document the public CLI and evidence format.

intent.problem: Verification is currently dominated by serial work even when independent checks could run concurrently, but naive parallelism can corrupt shared evidence or race on overlapping files.
constraints: No shell command strings; execute argv arrays only.
Conflict detection is conservative and deterministic.
intent.rationale: A reusable conflict-aware runner enables later parallel Work Items without weakening governance or evidence integrity.

scenarioCoverage.expected: They run concurrently within the worker bound and each result is retained.
They are placed in separate deterministic batches.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A job fails or the plan is invalid.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Failure is recorded per job; invalid input fails before execution.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized the complete 14-WI implementation plan, including the bounded parallel-verification schema.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
